Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for launch has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally projected, and that certification step has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. The new delivery date is 14 April.

Our team is continuing work on every component that doesn't depend on the certification, so this delay will not compound further once the integration clears. We're maintaining close contact with the vendor to confirm the certification timeline and will flag immediately if anything changes.

Does 14 April still work well with your own internal planning and launch commitments? Please let us know if you'd like to set up a call to walk through the revised schedule in detail.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
